final: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, p.avg_anlycount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM per_transaction p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall, avg_anlycount - (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) FROM kept) AS above_kept FROM kept ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
